newsitem.title: USA: Cymer files for 1.7 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Cymer files for 1.7 million shares.

text.p: Cymer Inc Tuesday filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up 1.7 million common shares.

Of the total, one million common shares will be offered by the company and 700,000 common shares will be sold by stockholders, the filing said. After the offering, outstanding common will total 13,419,456 shares.

The stockholders have granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 255,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Montgomery Securities and Needham & Co Inc.
The San Diego, Calif.,-based company said net proceeds will be used for the expansion of manufacturing capacity and general corporate purposes, including working capital.

Cymer is a provider of excimer laser illumination sources for use in deep ultraviolet photolithography systems targeted at the pilot and volume production segments of the semiconductor manufacturing market.
